text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said Wednesday it had completed a $6.4 million financing, which it said would provide funds for oil and gas operations in Kazakhstan, asphalt marketing in Louisiana and to repay its outstanding note to MG Trade Finance.
It said the financing was in the form of two-year eight percent convertible debentures and that it also issued two- year warrants to buy 960,000 shares of its common stock at $2.71 per share.

The company said it is negotiating with a major U.S. investment banking firm to obtain non-equity financing to repay the eight percent debentures and to fund its continuing operations in Kazakhstan and Louisiana.

"The company felt it is advisable at this time to bolster its balance sheet with this interim financing while negotiating with both the Kazakhstan and the Venezuelan governments," American International said in a statement.
